results.goal: Format current timestamp using time.strftime and write to timestamp.txt
results.final_source:
import time
ts = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
with open("timestamp.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ts + "\n")

results.goal: Compute sum of numbers 1 to 10 and verify it equals 55 in result.txt
results.final_source:
total = sum(range(1, 11))  # Corrected the range to include 10
assert total == 55, f"Expected total 55 but got {total}"
with open("result.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
